name: Chronomancer: Incarnation of Chaos resets Chromatic Shard (#7467)
contract: Incarnation of Chaos 570067 (3 min cooldown) reads 'instantly resetting the cooldown of Chromatic Shard'. Its DBC effects are two spellmods and a +% damage aura; no effect or script performed the reset, so Chromatic Shard (801292 and ranks 501836-501840, 574346, 567543-567544, 30 s category cooldown) stayed on cooldown after Incarnation. chronomancer_secondary_casts now removes the cooldown of every known Chromatic Shard rank when Incarnation of Chaos is cast.

steps.label: SETUP: Chromatic Shard is on cooldown
